consumer_views.statement:
1. For the rational strictly positive POVM-pair class above, complete SLD dominance is coRE-complete under computable many-one reductions; failure is RE-complete.
2. For every finite-dimensional channel pair, complete SLD order is equivalent to the stated unrestricted complete Umegaki relative-entropy order. Consequently the same coRE/RE classification applies to that POVM class and entropy order.
3. No total computable function of a valid rational POVM pair bounds a reference dimension sufficient to witness every failure of complete SLD order.
4. For strictly positive POVMs the source defines a finite bounded entropy defect V(E,F). No total algorithm approximates V at every requested rational additive tolerance, and that even additive error 1/4 is impossible uniformly over the same rational-complex strictly positive POVM class. The fixed-error claim uses a computable positive witness margin and finite tensor amplification; it is not presented as an efficiency result.

contract.assumptions: The source limits the hardness claim to generic complex POVMs with variable dimensions. It does not assert hardness for transpose-compatible/restricted subclasses, fixed input dimension, equal-reference-marginal entropy order, numerical contraction coefficients, or a general Hermiticity-preserving-lift characterization. It gives no efficient witness-finding procedure.
costs: Computable many-one reductions;finite symbolic construction,no efficiency or strategy/witness-acquisition guarantee.
Every failure has some finite witness;the result rules out a uniform computable sufficient dimension bound,not every restricted-case algorithm.
contract.obstruction: Permits programme reasoning from complete-order undecidability without imposing an unavailable computable ancilla cutoff or reopening the accepted proof. It supplies no physical implementation,novelty or practical-advantage evidence.
contract.provides: Programme-accepted complete SLD coRE-completeness for variable-dimensional rational-complex strictly positive POVM pairs; unrestricted complete Umegaki equivalence; no total computable sufficient reference cutoff; and the source-defined bounded entropy-defect additive-approximation obstruction, including uniform additive error1/4. Preserve the source-defined normalization and full stated scope.
contract.requires:
Each test is finite-dimensional, with dimensions not bounded uniformly over instances. A POVM E=(E_i) on C^a has positive effects summing to I_a; “strictly positive” means every E_i>0. The classified inputs are pairs of rational-complex strictly positive POVMs on a common input, where real and imaginary matrix entries are rational and the input dimension and outcome counts are part of the finite description.

For channels P,Q with common input, the note defines complete SLD order by comparison of the SLD quadratic forms for every finite untouched reference R, faithful input state rho, and traceless Hermitian tangent H. It defines unrestricted complete Umegaki relative-entropy order by D(P_R(alpha)||P_R(beta)) >= D(Q_R(alpha)||Q_R(beta)) for every finite R and every input-state pair alpha,beta; there is no equal-reference-marginal condition.
contract.units: Dimensionless complete SLD quadratic-form / Umegaki entropy order;source-local halved SLD versus unhalved Sylvester convention.
